headline: OpenAI launches GPT 5.6 with new model sizes and pricing.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT 5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna
items.summary: OpenAI has launched the GPT 5.6 family of models, which includes the Luna, Terra, and Sol models, varying in size and pricing. The models are priced per million input/output tokens with Luna at $1/$6, Terra at $2.50/$15, and Sol at $5/$30. These models promise improved performance and scalability for diverse applications. The release aims to cater to different computational needs and budget constraints while offering enhanced capabilities.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads should note the potential for integrating these models into AI-powered applications for enhanced performance and scalability.

items.title: Fine-tune NVIDIA Nemotron 3 models with Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization
items.summary: The article details how NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 models can be fine-tuned using Amazon SageMaker's serverless model customization. It provides a comprehensive guide on the unique architecture of Nemotron 3, the fine-tuning techniques available, and how to set up the serverless environment with SageMaker Studio.

items.title: Deploying quantized models on Amazon SageMaker AI with Unsloth
items.summary: This post introduces four deployment patterns for models quantized with Unsloth on AWS infrastructure. It covers using Amazon EC2 for direct access and Amazon SageMaker AI for managed services, offering flexibility in deploying and managing quantized models efficiently.

items.title: Reducing High-Bandwidth Memory Bottlenecks in JAX-Based LLM Training with Host Offloading
items.summary: NVIDIA explores methods to alleviate high-bandwidth memory bottlenecks in JAX-based LLM training by utilizing host offloading techniques. This approach aims to optimize data workflows and improve model training efficiency on JAX frameworks.

items.title: Show HN: Mindwalk – Replay coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of your codebase
items.summary: Mindwalk, showcased on Hacker News, is a tool that allows developers to replay coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of their codebase. This tool aims to enhance code exploration and understanding by providing a spatial representation of code interactions.

all_items.title: Real-time dental image verification with Amazon SageMaker AI at Henry Schein One
all_items.summary: This post describes how Henry Schein One closed that gap by building Image Verify, an AI-powered quality verification system on Amazon SageMaker AI that evaluates dental X-ray quality at the point of capture, in real time, across thousands of locations. The system went from concept to over 10,000 active locations within months and has already processed over 11 million X-rays and growing at 1.5 million per week. Henry Schein One is now scaling toward 40,000 locations globally across four regions.

all_items.title: How KTern.AI built agentic AI for SAP on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: Evolving from a traditional software as a service (SaaS) platform into a next-generation agentic AI platform meant orchestrating multiple specialized agents across long-running enterprise programs.
